text:
maya_ops: Quick notice for APAC capacity teams — we're rebalancing L40s Dedicated pools in ap-northeast-2 (Seoul) and soft-launching an A10G reserved pool for select customers. Short summary below. :loudspeaker:

cheng_infra: Why move? We're seeing sustained high PLG demand causing long tails for small Dedicated reservations. Rebalance moves underutilized L40s from non-reserved pools into a reserved buffer, and introduces A10G reserved nodes for cost-sensitive enterprise workloads.

maya_ops: Implementation details: (1) convert 16 L40-GPUs from `l40s-standard-1` into `l40s-reserved-buffer` (2) create `a10g-reserved-seoul` pool with 20 GPUs for invited customers. Both are non-disruptive to running jobs.

cheng_infra: Config pushed to infra-config: `infra-config/services/dedicated/pools/ap-northeast-2/*.yaml`

```yaml
# l40s-reserved-buffer-apn2.yaml
pool_name: l40s-reserved-buffer-apn2
capacity_gpus: 16
allocation_policy: reserved-buffer
buffer_ttl: 6h  # nodes returned to standard pool after idle TTL
preemption: false
note: "temporary rebalance to improve small-reservation fulfillment"

# a10g-reserved-seoul.yaml
pool_name: a10g-reserved-seoul
capacity_gpus: 20
availability: invite_only
allocation_policy: reserved-first
quality_tier: standard
billing_profile: reserved_a10g
```

deploy-bot: infra-config v1.42 deployed by cheng_infra — deploy id `deploy-2026-03-25-0847` :rocket:

rachel_cs: Customer impact? We'll need a CS blurb and note for account teams. Does this affect existing reserved contracts?

maya_ops: No impact to existing reserved commitments. This rebalance targets standard and PLG pools only. A10G reserved pool is invite-only; enterprise contracts that requested cost-optimized options get first access.

hitoshi_apac: APAC ops is warming the A10G nodes now and running NVLink/PCIe validation. I'll post the perf charts for A10G vs L40s on seq=256 workloads to the console tomorrow morning.

sam_sre: Monitoring + alerts: added `l40s_buffer_fill`, `a10g_reserved_fill`, `queue_age_by_size_apn2`. Temporary alert: if `queue_age_p95>30m` after the change roll, roll back buffer allocation and page SRE. Also added autoscale hooks to reallocate nodes back to `l40s-standard-1` if buffer usage <10% for 12h.

finance-bot: Note: A10G reserved pricing tier applied to billed reservations in `a10g-reserved-seoul`. Finance will mark initial invite customers with a 20% pilot discount for the first 30 days.

rachel_cs: Draft status blurb for support: "We performed a temporary rebalance of L40s Dedicated capacity in Seoul to improve reservation fulfillment times. We also opened an invite-only A10G reserved pool for select customers. No action required for most users; account teams will contact invited customers with details." Will paste in #support for review. :memo:

cheng_infra: Risk/rollback: conversion is non-disruptive, nodes are drained before changing pool assignment. Rollback plan: revert pool membership in infra-config and redeploy; drain policy preserves existing tasks. ETA for full visibility: 6	6h.

maya_ops: Timeline: change applied now, observe for 24h, then evaluate whether to keep buffer or convert to permanent reserved tier. If perf looks good we may expand A10G invites next week.

hitoshi_apac: Ping me for shadowing metrics or if you want to join the live warmup.

sam_sre: Oncall rota for next 48h: sam_sre, cheng_infra, and jules_sre. Check `dedicated.ap-northeast-2.*` dashboards.

maya_ops: Thanks team. I'll follow up with a short post in #eng-postmortems after the 24h check and attach raw metrics. :white_check_mark:
